mentions.name: Custom metal printer slicer
mentions.description: A custom slicer for a special metal 3D printer design, replacing the needed VTK library version with a simpler Blender Geometry Nodes solution to extract texture information and infill hull features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also still working on a custom Slicer for a special metal printer design. The VTK library version needed replaced by a simpler Blender Geometry nodes solution to extract texture information, and infill hull features.
